notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only. Own tab, navigated to https://jysk.dk/robots.txt and ran every subsequent request as a same-origin fetch() from that page via javascript_tool. No block, challenge, 403 or rate limit at any point (~75 requests, paced ~1.2s apart). robots.txt re-checked live: Disallow /customer/, /checkout/, /b2b/, *filters=*, *sort=*, /search for User-agent: * - no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-User rule, so no opt-out applies; no disallowed path was fetched. TREE: three sources unioned per the mandatory cross-check - (1) https://jysk.dk/sitemap.xml (single file, 6121 URLs; a path is a category iff other URLs sit beneath it), (2) each department landing page's own category-tile block (/stue, /spisestue, /kontor, /entre, /opbevaring, /sovevaerelse, /have, /indretning, /badevaerelse), (3) a per-leaf scan listing every same-branch link on a listing page that is NOT in that page's JSON-LD ItemList, i.e. a subcategory tile rather than a product. The sitemap is stale (lastmod 2025-10): it missed all four Havemoebelsaet children and its product counts are wrong (Spiseborde 59 vs 242 live), so it was used for structure only, never for qty. The /badevaerelse tree was walked in full and is towels, mats, robes, shower curtains and accessories only - JYSK DK sells no bathroom furniture. COUNTS: jysk.dk publishes no rendered 'N products' header anywhere (checked the loaded page's DOM text), so per brief rule 4 the count comes from the page itself: every category page server-renders its complete product grid and qty is the number of product cards in it (data-testid=product-card-title). Proven safe: on /stue/sofaer the SSR HTML and the fully hydrated live DOM both give 123, there is no pagination or load-more control, and the grid is not lazy-loaded. The page's JSON-LD ItemList numberOfItems is quoted alongside in every evidence string; it equals the rendered count on 38 of 42 counted leaves and is higher on four (Sofas 124/123, Continental Beds 102/78 and its storage child 10/7, the Adjustable-Beds parent 42/33), where the surplus are non-rendered variant/configuration articles - the rendered figure was taken and the difference flagged. JYSK QUIRK, documented in every affected flag: sibling categories cross-list. A leaf's grid often contains products whose own category is a sibling or child - Sofas carries Sofa Beds, Dining Tables carries Dining Sets, Desks and Height-Adjustable Desks serve one identical 47-item union, Office Chairs and Gaming Chairs one identical 31-item union, Wardrobes carries wardrobe fittings, Sun Loungers carries sun-lounger cushions, Lounge Sets carries Cafe Sets. qty is the site's own listing for that URL in every case; the own-canonical subset is stated in the flag so the merge can net the overlap. TRAP CONFIRMED: a JYSK slug does not 404, it serves a plausible wrong listing. /have/havemobler/havebaenke (Garden Benches) returns the entire 115-item Garden Furniture rollup with no bench in it, and havemobelsaet-i-trae / -i-metal / -i-nonwood each return the same 3 Cafe Set products. Every recorded leaf was checked against this by confirming its h1 matches the node asked for and that its items are canonical under it. EXCLUDED, with reasons: MATTRESSES - the whole /sovevaerelse/madrasser branch (foam, spring, topper, roll-up, children's) as bedding per the assignment, plus duvets, pillows, bed linen, sheets, pillowcases and bedspreads; Beds and Bed Frames kept. Furniture parts and care: bed legs, bed accessories, slats, elevation-bed components, dining-table extension leaves (/spisestue/tillaegsplader-til-spiseborde, 7), living-room furniture care and accessories, office accessories. /opbevaring/hylder (23) excluded on its own h1 - 'Vaeghylder, svaevehylder og billedhylder' = wall shelves, floating shelves and picture ledges, i.e. Wall Decor, not freestanding shelving. /entre/entremobler/knageraekker (10) excluded as wall-mounted hook rails. Standalone storage goods excluded: storage boxes and baskets, plastic boxes, small storage, hangers, wardrobe interior fittings, and /have/udendorsopbevaring (4) which is cushion boxes. Also excluded: all textiles and rugs, curtains, garden cushions, sun protection (parasols, awnings, pavilions), trampolines, camping (tents, sleeping bags, air mattresses, picnic), garden decoration and pots, outdoor and indoor lighting, mirrors, decoration, kitchen and tableware, pet supplies, and children's rugs (the only child of /indretning/borneartikler). Children's furniture (/indretning/bornemobler, 8) IS included. SANITY CHECKS: counts vary per category (no site-wide constant); no suspiciously round value; every recorded h1 matches the requested node; two reads taken on the large leaves - Dining Tables drifted 246 to 242 within the session and is flagged, while Dining Table Sets 176, Sofas 123 and Wardrobes 77 were stable across reads.
